name: butt
blurb: butt (broadcast using this tool) is an easy to use, multi OS streaming tool.
description: butt (broadcast using this tool) is an easy to use, multi OS streaming tool. It supports SHOUTcast, Icecast, WebRTC and runs on Linux, Mac OS X and Windows (64 Bit only since version 0.1.20). The main purpose of butt is to stream live audio data from your computers Mic or Line input to a Shoutcast, Icecast or WebRTC server. If you want you can also record your session.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
